detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

5-Amino-1MQ (Encapsulated Solid)

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: 5-Amino-1-methylquinolinium
  • Molecular Formula: C₁₀H₁₁N₂⁺
  • Molecular Weight: ~159.21 g/mol
  • Compound Class: Small-molecule quinolinium derivative
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

5-Amino-1MQ is a synthetic small-molecule compound belonging to the quinolinium chemical class. This product is supplied in an encapsulated solid format to support controlled handling, storage, and measurement within laboratory research environments.

Unlike peptide-based materials, 5-Amino-1MQ is produced via chemical synthesis and is not composed of amino acid chains. The encapsulated format is provided solely as a physical containment method and does not imply any route of administration. This material is intended exclusively for in-vitro laboratory research conducted by qualified professionals.

Research Applications:
  • In-vitro evaluation of small-molecule behavior in biochemical or enzymatic assay systems
  • Laboratory investigation of structure–activity relationships of quinolinium derivatives
  • Analytical method development involving non-peptide research compounds
  • Comparative studies of small-molecule analogs under controlled experimental conditions
Storage and Handling:
  • Store in a cool, dry environment away from direct light
  • Maintain container tightly sealed when not in use
  • Handle using appropriate laboratory safety and aseptic techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications.
  • Format: Encapsulated solid research material
  • Appearance: White to off-white solid
  • Solubility: Soluble in water and polar organic solvents (following capsule removal for analysis)
Compliance Notice:

5-Amino-1MQ is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
